map.哮喘 GINA 控制水平评估器 使用指南: Asthma GINA Control Level Assessor User Guide
map.依据 GINA 近4周控制评估及 ACT(哮喘控制测试)量表，判断哮喘控制水平并: Judges asthma control level from the GINA 4-week control assessment and the ACT (Asthma Control Test) scale, and guides stepping treatment up or down
map.：GINA 四问全阴性→控制良好，维持当前阶梯，每 3–6 月复评。: : GINA four questions all negative means well controlled, maintain the current step and review every 3-6 months.
map.：ACT 5 题总分 20/25→部分控制，需升级治疗并随访。: : ACT 5 questions total 20/25 means partial control, so treatment should be stepped up with follow-up.

map.GINA 与 ACT 选谁？: Which to choose, GINA or ACT?
map.GINA 为控制问卷、ACT 为症状+活动量表；联合更全面。: GINA is a control questionnaire and ACT a symptom plus activity scale; using both together is more comprehensive.
map.部分控制怎么办？: What if control is only partial?
map.部分控制提示需升阶梯或更换吸入技术，2–4 周后复评。: Partial control means stepping up or changing inhaler technique is needed, with review after 2-4 weeks.
